An '''icecrawler''' was a type of ground vehicle that was used for traveling across the frozen terrain of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Syned]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jarrow Rusher]] and members of [[Rusher's Brigade]] stole an icecrawler known as "[[Crawler One]]" and used it during an attack on the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Calimondretta]].
